descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S16 Open sign-up: a never-invited email sees the branded sign-in screen, signs in with a code, meets the agreements screen, is created once and sees no other physician's patient

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 Open sign-up: a new email that was never invited signs in with the emailed code. The physician is created and appears in the physician list. (UAT OAT-01 step 6; UAT OAT-01 Expected; TFA-94513 AC 13) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress
  • T1 The sign-in screen says 'Round Companion' (not 'RoundAI') and 'Sign in or create an account with a code sent to your email'. (TFA-94513 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress
  • U1 Sign-in is by email one-time passcode only: no password field and no shared or static PIN anywhere. The only exception is the two app review accounts, which use a fixed code. (UAT OAT-01 step 1; UAT OAT-01 Expected; TFA-94513 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given A signed-out browser, an unseeded address qa-signup-<tag>@roundai.test, and a second fixture physician who owns one Hospital patient

When The agent reads the sign-in screen, enters the address, presses Send sign-in code, enters the code the runner gives and presses Sign in; then ticks both boxes and presses Continue; then opens the other physician's patient by URL

Then The sign-in screen says 'Round Companion' and 'Sign in or create an account with a code sent to your email', with an Email field and Send sign-in code and no password. Sign-in succeeds and lands on the agreements screen. After Continue the Hospital list opens without the other physician's patient, and the deep link shows no chart. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs checkpoints plus a physician-list read: T1 copy and U1 no password on cp1; cp2 only confirms that the new account reaches the agreements screen (its content is judged in S03-S05); one record for the email = Pass, none or two = Fail (U6); the other physician's patient on cp3 or cp4 = Fail (open-sign-up isolation, as S13 at the server). …

Where it ran: local probes (multi-device probes); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S16 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane probes.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: probes.

UAT item: OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-01/S16

Open sign-up: a never-invited email sees the branded sign-in screen, signs in with a code, meets the agreements screen, is created once and sees no other physician's patient

Tickets: TFA-94513 Signing In & Session Security (in progress)

New local lane probes: status passed in probes/results.json → passed (passed).

How it is tested (probes/plan.json, automatable: yes): Scripted probe: signed-out context, unseeded qa-signup-<tag>@roundai.test; check sign-in copy, sign in (send stubbed, code from seed:issueTestOtp), agreements screen, tick + Continue, Hospital list without the other physician's patient, deep link to the foreign chart shows nothing; count physician records for the email via the betterAuth adapter (indexed, read-only). — session-control, second account (freshAccount) and an indexed admin read are all local.

Detail:

Branded copy, Email + Send sign-in code, no password/'RoundAI'; the unseeded address signs in and lands on the agreements screen; Continue opens /rounding without the other physician's patient; the deep link shows no chart; exactly one betterAuth user row for the address with createdAt. Which table is 'the physician list' is Q4 (recorded). Oracle note: cp3 mustNotContain 'Before you start' collides with the list's baseline-survey card ('Before you start: a 2-minute baseline survey'); the agreements screen is recognised by its own heading/BAA text instead.

Evidence: 3 attached.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Open sign-up: the agent creates a new account with an emailed code, a second physician is seeded and the Better Auth user table is read with the admin key.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
